params.style_prompt: Convert to pixel art, flat colors, clean crisp pixels, limited palette

card.architecture: DreamOmni2 (quanto-int8 FLUX.1-Kontext pipeline + VLM) with per-step pixel-manifold projection injected INTO the pipeline node + final PixelQuantize
card.summary: Pixel art via DreamOmni2's reference editor: the projection runs inside the self-contained pipeline (decode the x0 estimate -> grid+palette quantize -> re-encode -> blend) every denoise step. Attach one reference, or the source doubles as its own. Slow (int8 + CPU-offloaded VLM).
card.pick_when: You want DreamOmni2's reference-based editing to drive the pixel-art conversion.
